en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in rolling countryside. In the foreground is a pasture with grazing cows. Behind it lies a cluster of traditional gabled houses and farm buildings surrounded by trees. Dominating the center-right is a large white church or abbey with two tall, slender spires and a baroque or neo-gothic appearance. The background shows patchwork fields and low wooded hills under a cloudy sky, with overhanging tree branches framing the top of the image. No visible printed caption or handwriting can be seen on the front.
